scope: Same joined deck and PWL input; native ngspice 45.2 versus eval2 WASM; 20us post-analysis linearized grid, 0.4s. Unexcluded errors and edge/settled errors reported separately; this is numerical model comparison, not hardware validation.

criteria.limitations: The original 20mV pointwise criterion fails at edges. These declared separate timing/amplitude checks characterize that failure; they do not establish exact equality.
